criteria.name: dramatic_tension
criteria.description: Each scene has a clear dramatic_question that creates real stakes. The tension is specific — not just conflict for its own sake but a question the reader wants answered.

criteria.name: character_specificity
criteria.description: character_states describe concrete emotional positions and objectives entering the scene, not vague moods. Each character's state is distinct from the others.

criteria.name: structural_progression
criteria.description: what_changes is concrete and meaningful — something genuinely shifts by scene's end. The revelation (if any) would land if dramatized. Scenes escalate appropriately across the story arc.

criteria.name: downstream_utility
criteria.description: All required fields are populated with usable content. setting_id matches an available setting. character_ids are valid and appropriate. A dialogue writer could use this scene spec directly.
